title: Evaluation of Fidaxomicin in the Treatment of Clostridium Difficile Infection (CDI)
brief_summary: This is a single center collection of discarded biological samples and electronic medical review (EMR) data on patients who are hospitalized with clostridium difficile infections and treated with Fidaxomicin
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. ≥18 years of age
2. Currently an inpatient at UPMC Presbyterian
3. Diagnosed with an CDI
4. Being treated with Fidaxomicin

Exclusion Criteria:

not meeting entry criteria
study_population: Patients diagnosed with CDI and treated with fidaxomicin and seen at PUH
